tasks.title: Audit 12 direct habit-app competitors
tasks.description: Produce a structured teardown of 12 habit apps covering onboarding, daily loop, rewards, friction and pricing.
acceptance_criteria: A comparison table with 12 named apps and all five dimensions populated.

tasks.title: Audit 8 adjacent-category products
tasks.description: Analyze eight games, learning, planning or self-care apps for transferable engagement patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Eight documented product examples, each with one mechanism, user benefit and transfer risk.

tasks.title: Create competitor feature inventory
tasks.description: Normalize observed competitor capabilities into a deduplicated feature taxonomy.
acceptance_criteria: At least 30 features categorized by onboarding, action, progression, social, personalization or monetization.

tasks.title: Document competitor anti-patterns
tasks.description: Identify friction, guilt mechanisms, confusing UX and unsupported health claims.
acceptance_criteria: At least 15 anti-patterns with an observed example and proposed design guardrail.

tasks.title: Build behavior-change evidence register
tasks.description: Summarize peer-reviewed evidence for cues, goals, reinforcement, self-monitoring and habit automaticity.
acceptance_criteria: Each mechanism has a citation, population, evidence strength, limitation and implementation implication.

tasks.title: Create prevention-action evidence rubric
tasks.description: Define a method for rating health-action safety and evidence without implying personal disease-risk reduction.
acceptance_criteria: Rubric includes evidence grade, contraindications, claim limits, review owner and review date.

tasks.title: Write user recruitment screener
tasks.description: Define inclusion criteria for abandoned-app users, successful habit builders and busy beginners.
acceptance_criteria: Screener includes segment definitions, exclusion rules and 8–12 neutral questions.

tasks.title: Run 15 behavioral interviews
tasks.description: Interview users about actual attempts, contexts, triggers and obstacles.
tasks.blocked_reason: Requires human-subject research (15 real recruited/consented/transcribed interviews) which cannot be executed in an autonomous overnight build. Reviewer rejected a prior synthetic-record attempt (PROGRESS.md 2026-11-22) and forbade advancing constructed records through the research gate. Field-ready instruments delivered in docs/research/behavioral-interview-protocol-and-analysis-framework.md; empirical record requirement remains open. Unblock path and definition-of-done documented in that file (§6–§7).
acceptance_criteria: 15 anonymized interview records and a coded synthesis of at least five recurring barriers.

tasks.title: Run 14-day diary study
tasks.description: Capture real-world opportunities and failures to perform tiny health actions.
tasks.blocked_reason: Requires human-subject research (≥10 real participants making in-the-moment entries across 14 real calendar days) which cannot be executed in an autonomous overnight build. Same class of blocker as TASK-008, which the Reviewer blocked while explicitly forbidding synthetic human-subject records through the research gate and naming TASK-009 as a likely same-class blocker (PROGRESS.md 2026-11-22). Field-ready instruments delivered in docs/research/diary-study-protocol-and-analysis-framework.md: 14-day hybrid protocol (§2–§3), context-map framework + empty T×R template (§4), and three precisely-defined completion-rate formulas with empty result slots (§5). Empirical requirement (≥10 complete diaries + populated context map + observed completion rate) remains OPEN. Unblock path and definition-of-done in that file (§7–§9). Marking blocked (not in_review) avoids fabricating the empirical deliverable and prevents a synthetic-data reject loop.
acceptance_criteria: At least 10 complete participant diaries, a context map and a documented completion rate.

tasks.title: Define primary audience and JTBD
tasks.description: Select a narrow launch segment using research evidence.
acceptance_criteria: One primary segment, top three jobs-to-be-done, exclusions and rationale documented.

tasks.title: Write Tiny Win concept brief
tasks.description: Specify one tiny daily action, reward loop and seven-day experience.
acceptance_criteria: Brief contains user promise, behavior hypothesis, 7-day storyboard and failure modes.

tasks.title: Write Growing World concept brief
tasks.description: Specify the virtual-world progression linked to real-world actions.
acceptance_criteria: Brief contains progression rules, 7-day storyboard, reward mechanics and failure modes.

tasks.title: Write Everyday Adventures concept brief
tasks.description: Specify contextual micro-missions and novelty model.
acceptance_criteria: Brief contains mission-selection logic, 7-day storyboard and failure modes.

tasks.title: Build interactive concept evaluation scorecard
tasks.description: Create a standalone weighted concept scoring component.
acceptance_criteria: Three concepts can be scored 1–5 on seven weighted criteria; totals recompute to 0–100; weights sum to 100.

tasks.title: Prototype three first-session flows
tasks.description: Build independently navigable first-session prototypes for the three concepts.
acceptance_criteria: Each prototype supports entry, goal selection, first action and completion without dead ends.

tasks.title: Run blinded concept desirability test
tasks.description: Compare concepts without revealing internal favorites.
acceptance_criteria: At least 18 participants; same script; preference, comprehension and qualitative reasons recorded.

tasks.title: Test App Store proposition variants
tasks.description: Compare three screenshots/headline propositions on equivalent audiences.
acceptance_criteria: Traffic, exposure, click-through and confidence limits reported separately per variant.

tasks.title: Run honest willingness-to-pay test
tasks.description: Test purchase intent with clear pricing and no deceptive checkout.
acceptance_criteria: At least two price points; actual commitment behavior and abandonment measured; no misleading charges.

tasks.title: Write concept selection decision record
tasks.description: Select or reject concepts based on observed evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Weighted score, research results, major uncertainties and explicit go/no-go decision documented.

tasks.title: Build Your Little Win Today card
tasks.description: Implement a standalone tappable/swipeable daily action card.
acceptance_criteria: Card displays title, effort, alternative and completion; touch and keyboard controls work; reduced-motion mode exists.

tasks.title: Add completion haptic feedback adapter
tasks.description: Implement optional platform haptics triggered only by successful completion.
acceptance_criteria: Supported iOS devices vibrate once on completion; unsupported devices silently degrade; setting disables haptics.

tasks.title: Design tiny-action fallback flow
tasks.description: Allow a user to reduce an action to a feasible alternative.
acceptance_criteria: Every sample action has an easier variant; switch takes at most two taps; progress is not penalized.

tasks.title: Build habit cue scheduler
tasks.description: Allow a user to associate an action with a time or existing routine.
acceptance_criteria: Create, edit and disable cues; timezone changes handled; notifications require opt-in.

tasks.title: Build evidence-reviewed action catalog
tasks.description: Represent curated health micro-actions as structured records.
acceptance_criteria: At least 20 records include category, duration, evidence grade, contraindications, easier variant and review date.

tasks.title: Implement action recommendation rules
tasks.description: Select a suitable micro-action from explicit preferences and exclusions.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic test cases cover goal fit, time availability, contraindication exclusions and no-match fallback.

tasks.title: Build daily action completion ledger
tasks.description: Record and display real-world action completion events.
acceptance_criteria: Events have unique IDs and timestamps; duplicate taps do not double-count; offline entries sync without loss.

tasks.title: Build gentle restart experience
tasks.description: Offer a non-punitive path after missed days.
acceptance_criteria: After 1, 3 or 7 missed days, restart requires at most two taps and no guilt/shame copy appears.

tasks.title: Build habit graduation state machine
tasks.description: Transition habits through new, practicing, stable and graduated states.
acceptance_criteria: Transition table is documented; unit tests cover every valid transition and rejected invalid transitions.

tasks.title: Build progressive challenge selector
tasks.description: Offer a slightly harder action only when user signals readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Users can accept, decline or revert; no automatic escalation after missed actions; choices persist.

tasks.title: Create visual and motion design tokens
tasks.description: Define a reusable premium visual language and accessible motion system.
acceptance_criteria: Tokens specify type, spacing, color, motion and contrast; all interactive elements meet WCAG 2.2 AA target.

tasks.title: Build seven-day journey preview
tasks.description: Show users how tiny actions could evolve across a week.
acceptance_criteria: Preview renders seven days, explains gradual progression and makes no unsupported health-outcome promises.

tasks.title: Create habit progress visualization
tasks.description: Show action consistency without punishing broken streaks.
acceptance_criteria: Displays completed opportunities and recovery; missing days never erase past progress; screen reader summary exists.

tasks.title: Instrument activation events
tasks.description: Define and emit events for onboarding, first action and first reward.
acceptance_criteria: Event schema documented; each event has anonymous user key, timestamp and schema version; no raw health details.

tasks.title: Build cohort retention dashboard
tasks.description: Calculate D1, D7, D30 and D90 app and behavior retention separately.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort definitions documented; test dataset yields expected rates; incomplete cohorts marked immature.

tasks.title: Implement habit automaticity survey
tasks.description: Capture periodic validated or clearly labeled exploratory automaticity measures.
acceptance_criteria: Survey version and attribution stored; optional completion; baseline and follow-up results can be compared.

tasks.title: Design reminder-reduction experiment
tasks.description: Test whether users continue actions when reminders are tapered.
acceptance_criteria: Randomization, eligibility, outcome window, consent and stopping rules pre-registered.

tasks.title: Build premium entitlement gate
tasks.description: Separate free one-habit experience from premium multi-habit features.
acceptance_criteria: Free user completes core loop; premium access requires valid entitlement; expired entitlement restores free access.

tasks.title: Build subscription economics model
tasks.description: Model install-to-paid conversion, platform fees, refunds, CAC and renewal scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Inputs editable; first-year contribution and sensitivity table recompute; assumptions visibly labeled.

tasks.title: Create onboarding usability test suite
tasks.description: Evaluate comprehension and effort in first-session UX.
acceptance_criteria: At least 12 moderated sessions; task success, time-to-first-action and critical usability issues reported.

tasks.title: Run 30-day behavioral pilot
tasks.description: Test feasibility and action persistence in a real cohort.
acceptance_criteria: Protocol, consent, attrition, completion, adverse events and behavior outcomes reported; no disease-prevention claims.

tasks.title: Build privacy and consent controls
tasks.description: Implement consent and data minimization for habit and optional health data.
acceptance_criteria: Consent can be withdrawn; export and deletion flows tested; no optional health data collected by default.

tasks.title: Prepare App Store editorial package
tasks.description: Assemble accurate product story, accessibility evidence, screenshots and feature nomination materials.
acceptance_criteria: Package includes tested US English copy, real screenshots, privacy disclosures, demo and claims review.

tasks.title: Create launch experiment plan
tasks.description: Define independent organic, referral, creator and paid acquisition experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Each channel has hypothesis, budget cap, attribution method, success threshold and stop condition.
